overview: This task graph generates a formal frozen-input FY2024 report for SenseTime (0020.HK). It starts with evidence gathering from frozen snapshots, performs financial and risk analysis, assembles the required sections with citations, and ends with verification.
research_topic: 商汤科技 (0020.HK) formal FY2024 frozen-input report
requirements: Cover executive summary, three statements or gaps, valuation or limitation, risks, and investment conclusion.
Emit explicitly labeled critical claims and body citations.

tasks.description: Gather frozen snapshot evidence for 0020.HK FY2024: executive summary, financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow), market data, valuation inputs, and risk factors. Use only frozen data.
tasks.expected_output: Evidence records with citations for all required sections.

tasks.description: Perform financial statement analysis and valuation for 0020.HK FY2024 using evidence from task_001. Compute ratios, trend coverage, three-statement view, peer comparison (if available), and valuation model. Identify any gaps in data.
tasks.expected_output: Claims with evidence_ids for financial metrics, valuation estimates, and data gaps.

tasks.description: Identify and analyze risks and limitations for 0020.HK FY2024 using evidence from task_001. Include operational, financial, market, and regulatory risks. Also note limitations of the frozen input data.
tasks.expected_output: Claims with evidence_ids for risks and limitations.

tasks.description: Assemble the final formal report in Chinese covering: executive summary, three statements (or gaps), valuation/limitation, risks, and investment conclusion. Use claims from task_002 and task_003. Ensure every critical claim has an evidence citation. Output as draft report strings in markdown, html, and json formats.
tasks.expected_output: Draft report with citations in markdown, HTML, JSON.

tasks.description: Verify the final report for compliance: every material factual claim must have an explicit evidence_id citation, no unsupported numbers or conclusions, all required sections present, and frozen input constraints respected. Return verification result.

data_sources: 0020.HK FY2024 frozen snapshot: annual report, financial statements, market data, analyst consensus (if available)
